title: Binary search for 23 in a sorted list of 10

frames.note: Look for 23. It can be anywhere in positions 0..9
Middle of 0..9 is 4: compare a[4] = 16 with 23
16 < 23: the target is to the right; throw away 4 and everything left of it
Middle of 5..9 is 7: compare a[7] = 56 with 23
56 > 23: the target is to the left; throw away 7 and everything right of it
Middle of 5..6 is 5: compare a[5] = 23 with 23
Found 23 at position 5, after 5 looks instead of up to 10
